---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HEARING AND SIGHT (Phase 028): loudness is the hearing radius, and hearing is not witnessing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
The same physical table as packs/bigville/world/hearing.json, so the standalone test pack keeps the
speech rules. Seed: seeds/bigville_loud_comm.json. Distances are Chebyshev grid cells. Witnesses get the
act (and the target, if in view), never the content. See the bigville pack for the sources of each figure:
sight_range 7 (seed lo_observe_act), flat_radius 11 (APPROX; worlds/bigville_sim_world.py HEAR_RANGE),
normal_loudness 1.0 and max_loudness 100.0 (bigville/backends/speech.py), occluders wall and tree (the sim
world's OCCLUDERS).
